scope: Offline reproduction of accepted saved-score arithmetic; no model execution or refitting.

populations.role: all original test-role tiles including partial SAR coverage

dino_c1.classifier: original training-standardized balanced C=1 logistic regression; saved probabilities only

final.loss: original batch sum of class weights denominator
final.selection: Keep original validation-selected epoch and per-fold/per-initialization LR; validate original tuning seed100, rates1e-4/1e-3/1e-2 and earliest maximum unrounded validation macro F1; lower LR resolves exact rate ties.

metric.scores: saved class probability column, exact recorded numeric values; no logits, rounding, calibration or score pooling
metric.tie_rule: descending exact score groups; consume whole tie groups
metric.AP: sum over distinct score groups of (new positives / total positives) * cumulative precision
metric.no_positive_labels: null AP and recall, explicit reason; not present in this primary grid
metric.reference: K/N is the all-tied prevalence reference, not the exact finite-sample expected random AP
metric.curves: all60 Craters curves, at all observed score groups; no added display endpoints

aggregation.macro: mean over all six class AP values in each cell; null if any undefined
aggregation.regional: seed means within each arm and fold; one pretrained DINO state versus five random states
aggregation.contrasts: pretrained minus baseline; CNN paired by seed, DINO one pretrained AP minus five-random-state mean
aggregation.geographic: equal mean over five regions, sample SD with ddof=1; no pooled score vectors
aggregation.undefined: null propagates; no silent class, seed or region omission

acceptance.scientific_result: exact equality to packaged results.json after excluding only execution metadata

limits: Exploratory analysis after inspection of multiclass errors and reused test regions.
Scores measure agreement with SAR-informed map labels, not independent geological detection or calibration.
Seeds are repeated training or initial states, not additional independent geographic regions.
Craters test counts8,1,14,61,48; the singleton region is sensitive to one positive rank and ties.
This package neither reruns model inference nor tests optimization adequacy, causal pretraining effects, alternate losses or epoch100 states.
